scenes.narration: Confidence is treated like something you are born with. It is actually built the same way every other skill is built.
It does not come from repeating affirmations. It comes from evidence. Your brain believes what it has seen you survive.
Avoidance is what kills it. Every time you dodge a hard thing, you teach yourself that you cannot handle it.
The correction is small deliberate exposure. Not the scariest thing. The next thing.
Tracking matters. Write down what you handled this week, because memory filters out anything that went fine.
You do not need to feel ready first. Action produces the evidence, and the evidence produces the feeling.
